chunks: Tell: My Lord has enjoined justice, and direct your faces at every mosque, and call upon Him, being sincere to Him in the religion, just as He began you, so you will return.

key_terms.وُجُوهَکُمْ: Your faces (indicating direction and focus of worship)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'directing your faces at every mosque' and 'sincerity in religion'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing 'al-Qist' (divine justice) as a core theological principle and emphasizes the universality of worship by directing believers to face any mosque, reflecting the flexibility in prayer orientation. The command to 'be sincere' (mukhlisin) underscores the necessity of pure intention (ikhlas) in all acts of devotion, linking the cyclical nature of creation and return to the consistency of divine command. This verse is often cited to support the idea that the physical direction of prayer is secondary to the spiritual orientation of the heart towards the Divine.
